Debrief DB-021
1) The actor carried out an unauthorized eviction campaign against protected residents.
2) Physical security and utility systems were modified without authorization.
3) Intimidation materials were delivered to the occupants.
4) Mandatory habitability and inspection procedures were bypassed.
